title: Fix auth/signup/logout state leakage and stale cached auto-login (frontend-only)

requirements.summary: Ensure post-signup the UI immediately binds to the newly authenticated principal and refreshes all user-scoped data (no reuse of previous user cache).
acceptanceCriteria: With a never-before-seen Internet Identity principal, after Internet Identity authentication the app shows the Profile Setup screen, signup succeeds, and the user can access the main app without seeing an Unauthorized/session-invalid error loop.
After signup completes, fetching the caller profile succeeds and returns the newly created profile for that principal (not a previous user).
Engineer accounts can create and view their own reports immediately after completing signup (without requiring an admin-only background step).

file_operations.description: Use the authorization component’s guidance on user-scoped caching to prevent cross-principal reuse: include the current principal (or an unauthenticated marker) in all user-specific React Query keys (e.g., currentUserProfile, isCallerAdmin, reports, report detail) and ensure signup mutations trigger refetch/invalidation of all principal-scoped queries needed for immediate app use (profile, role/admin flag, reports). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

After successful signup, force a clean post-signup data refresh for the active principal (invalidate/refetch principal-scoped profile/admin/reports queries) and prevent any UI reliance on previously cached profile data. Keep error handling user-friendly via existing translateSignupError. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Use the authorization component’s recommended pattern to prevent profile setup flash and stale data: adjust authenticated rendering gates to rely on principal-scoped profile query state (isFetched/isLoading tied to the current identity) so the main app never renders with an old principal’s cached profile. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Remove insecure client-side admin signup password validation and rely on backend rejection with clear UI messaging.
acceptanceCriteria: Admin signup can succeed when the correct admin signup password is provided (as defined/checked by the backend).

The frontend no longer contains a hardcoded admin signup password value comparison for validation; entering any non-empty value is allowed, and incorrect passwords are rejected by the backend with a user-facing error.
When admin signup is attempted with an incorrect password, the user sees a clear English error message and no privileged access is granted.

file_operations.description: Remove the hardcoded admin signup password comparison and only validate that an admin signup password is non-empty on the client; rely on backend response for correctness and display the translated error (e.g., 'Invalid admin signup password.') when rejected. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Harden admin password error messaging to ensure incorrect admin signup passwords are surfaced as a clear English message without leaking any sensitive details; keep behavior aligned with backend trap/reject patterns. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Strengthen full logout so identity/session and all cached user-specific UI state are cleared across refreshes (no auto-login to a prior user).
acceptanceCriteria: After clicking the app’s logout / switch-account action, the app reloads to an unauthenticated state and shows the Login screen (no automatic re-authentication).

After logout, previously viewed user-specific data (e.g., profile/report lists) is not shown again unless the user logs back in; switching to a different Internet Identity results in seeing only the new user’s data.
If the app detects a stale/invalid session state, the user is guided to perform a full logout and the flow results in a clean unauthenticated start state.

file_operations.description: Use the authorization component’s logout guidance to ensure full cleanup: cancel in-flight queries, clear/remove all React Query cached data, clear persisted AuthClient/II storage (existing utilities), and perform a deterministic reload that avoids restoring stale app state. Add brief in-code regression test notes for logout + account switching verification. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure logout UX uses the strengthened full logout path consistently (including disabling navigation/actions during logout) so no user-specific data can render during the transition. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the switch-account / stale-session cleanup flow uses the strengthened logout cleanup (skip-reload mode where appropriate) and does not allow any stale authenticated state to persist before a fresh login attempt. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add defensive UI/cache/actor-binding measures to prevent cross-account data exposure during identity transitions; document regression checks.
acceptanceCriteria: It is not possible to observe another user’s cached data after switching accounts (even briefly) during login/logout transitions.
Backend endpoints that return user-specific data enforce caller-based access correctly (non-admins cannot access other users’ profiles or reports).
Regression test steps are documented (in code comments or a short internal note) describing how to verify no stale identity/session persists after logout and account switching.

file_operations.description: Add identity-transition defenses: when the principal changes, immediately cancel and clear/remove all non-actor cached queries to prevent any stale user data from rendering while the new actor/profile loads; keep actor recreation keyed by principal. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure every user-specific query is principal-scoped (query keys include principal) and avoids leaking previous principal data via shared keys; where applicable, disable 'keep previous data' behavior for identity-changing queries to prevent brief cross-account flashes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add additional rendering guards so the app never renders user-specific pages while the current principal’s profile state is unresolved; keep SessionInvalidScreen as the guided recovery path for genuine auth errors. Add short regression verification comments (logout -> login as different II -> confirm no stale profile/reports shown). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
